source: An offline scan of collision-geometry dumps (the scene at seed 0 after the instance loads, as BEHAVIOR's evaluator loads it, only the activity's rooms (B100_task_misc.csv 'Rooms to include'); collision shapes on vertical rays every 4 cm between 0.15 m below and 2.6 m above the floor, over the task's objects and the robot's start plus 3 m). no_floor_beyond: door leaves with floor on one side and, 0.3-1.0 m beyond the other, no collision shape within 0.2 m of floor height (checked at 12 points per side); unverified_by_rooms: doors whose far side lies outside the scanned area and whose rooms say it is not loaded.
